capabilities: Publish selected notes and folders as Basecamp documents
Convert Markdown formatting, tables, callouts and code blocks to Basecamp rich text
Upload local embedded images and files as Basecamp attachments
Update existing documents in place and link notes to existing Basecamp pages
Sync manually or after edits with a configurable delay
disambiguation: Not two-way sync; it only publishes Obsidian notes to Basecamp and never imports edits made there back into the vault.
extras: A shared mkdev login service (basecamp-obsidian-sync.fodoj.com) exchanges authorization codes and renews tokens; its server code is private, so privacy-conscious users or organizations can register their own integration or supply an existing access token instead.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes as formatted documents in Basecamp or keep those documents updated after edits.

relations.evidence: Uses the official Basecamp TypeScript SDK.

summary: One-way publisher that syncs selected notes and folders from a vault as formatted documents in Basecamp Docs & Files, updating them in place on re-push.
